Bihar Government Office Holiday Schedule

Citizens planning to visit state government offices in Bihar during the final months of 2026 are advised to check the official calendar beforehand. The Bihar government has released its official holiday schedule for the year, detailing both gazetted and restricted holidays applicable to state government employees.

Understanding Gazetted and Restricted Holidays

  • Gazetted Holidays: These are officially declared government holidays where major state offices and routine services remain closed.
  • Restricted Holidays: State government employees are generally permitted to select up to three restricted holidays from an approved list throughout the year, subject to applicable rules.

It is important to note that a government office holiday does not automatically mean all public services are entirely suspended. While physical offices remain closed on gazetted holidays, certain online services may continue to function, and emergency departments operate under their own distinct schedules.

Practical Implications and Verification

  • Plan Ahead: Individuals needing to submit documents, register certificates, or complete time-sensitive paperwork should confirm office schedules before traveling.
  • Official Sources: Citizens can cross-verify dates using the National Portal of India or the official Bihar government notification and e-Gazette.
